verdict.rationale: Clara documents its own per-card spending limits that reset on a monthly, weekly or daily schedule, plus merchant, time and day restrictions. Those limits are a real enforcement mechanism at the card level. However, there is no evidence of team or project budget objects that card limits or approvals roll up to and enforce. Project labels apply only to transactions after the fact, and approvals appear only in a marketing line about expense reporting. Missing for 10: budget allocation to teams/projects, enforcement of budgets via card limits, approval workflows tied to budgets, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can allocate budgets to teams and projects and have card limits and approvals actually enforce them
